title: 第五章 红颜祸水第六章 我跟定你了
content_zh:
萧凉微微侧过脸去，离着他和苏清绾不到五尺的距离，一身着华丽衣衫的青年手持折扇，嘴角泛着微微笑意。
青年的目光一直在苏清绾身上打转，至于与苏清绾并肩的萧凉，则是直接被忽略掉。
“没兴趣，我又不认识你！”苏清绾秀眉微微一皱，这人的衣衫很华丽，但那张脸却是很普通，与萧凉相比，实在没啥可比性。
用餐？她连多看一眼的兴趣都没有。
“呵呵，刚才我们的确不认识，我们现在不就认识了？”陈君浩折扇打开，轻轻摇动，可见其撩妹的确是有一套的。
“可是姑奶奶我不想认识你！”苏清绾拉着萧凉的手，转身就要离开。
却在这时，陈君浩的人同时出动，挡在了大门之处，气氛瞬间紧张起来。
萧凉面色变了变，苏清绾不知道陈君浩，但萧凉却是知道的。
这家伙是宁国公陈庆的儿子，是不折不扣的大熙当朝权贵，别看他人畜无害的模样，实际上却是出名的心狠手辣，被其打残的人不知道有多少，乃是大熙京城一害。
今日这般境况，显然是看上苏清绾了，真是红颜祸水啊。
但这是他萧凉的未婚妻，如何能让她被人欺负？
可转而间萧凉却是想到，苏清绾是何等深不可测的存在，单纯不过是装出来的。
更何况以目前的情况来看，他这炼气四层的修为，恐怕也英雄救不了美。
最为关键的，萧凉想要试探一下苏清绾的深浅，这是一个极好的机会。
看到苏清绾竟然主动去拉萧凉的手，又看到萧凉那张英俊至极的脸，陈君浩怒火顿然熊熊燃烧。
萧凉下意识地挣开了苏清绾的手，往后退了几步。
“姑娘，咱们现在可以好好的用餐了吗？”陈君浩脸上露出笑意。
苏清绾指着萧凉大声说道：“我有未婚夫了！”
萧凉急忙闪入人群中，这惹火烧身的事他才不干。
“姑娘看人的眼光可不准啊！”陈君浩神色陡然一沉，杀机迸发。

苏清绾却是一跺脚，再次看向人群，萧凉已经不见。
这家伙竟然就这般将她扔下自个逃走了？苏清绾洁白的牙齿咬得紧紧的。
可这般姿态，落在陈君浩的眼中，却是格外可爱灵动，说不出来的喜欢。
“王八蛋，看我回去不收拾你！”苏清绾正打算离去，却是被陈君浩再次挡住了去路。
“别惹我，我现在心情不好！”苏清绾警告说道。
陈君浩笑道：“是吗？我一定会让你开心的！”
“看来是听不懂人话了！”苏清绾袖子撸起，一股浑厚力量陡然呼啸而出，挡在前面的几人瞬间被震飞出去，砸在屋门之上。
砰砰之声传开，四海酒楼的宾客都被惊动了，齐齐往这边看来。
陈君浩面色陡然大变，不由自主地向后退去。
苏清绾却是看也不看他一眼，转身出了大门。
萧凉并未走远，而是藏在不远之处暗中看着，他早先就知道苏清绾不是泛泛之辈，但却没想到如此厉害。
那陈君莫的手下，其中有一人修为已经进入了第二境天罡境，灵力化罡，却是没能接住苏清绾随手一击。
“苏雨涵是极品灵根不假，可是这个苏清绾亦是深不可测，苏家这两姐妹还真是没个省油的灯，她这种人按理说来可以选择不回来的。”
“看来此女也是在谋划着些什么，苏继，李红艳，接下来苏府的好戏应该会很精彩了！”
content_en:
Xiao Liang turned his face slightly, and less than five feet away from him and Su Qingwan, there was a young man in gorgeous clothes holding a folding fan with a smile on his lips.
The young man's eyes kept turning on Su Qingwan. As for Xiao Liang, who was standing side by side with Su Qingwan, he was directly ignored.
"I'm not interested, I don't know you!" Su Qingwan frowned slightly. This man's clothes were very gorgeous, but his face was very ordinary. Compared with Xiao Liang, there was really no comparison.
Dining? She wasn't even interested in taking another look.
"Haha, we didn't know each other just now, don't we know each other now?" Chen Junhao opened his folding fan and shook it gently, which showed that he did have a way to seduce girls.
"But grandma, I don't want to know you!" Su Qingwan took Xiao Liang's hand and turned to leave.
But at this moment, Chen Junhao's people moved out at the same time to block the door, and the atmosphere instantly became tense.
Xiao Liang's expression changed. Su Qingwan didn't know Chen Junhao, but Xiao Liang knew it.
This guy is the son of Ning Guogong Chen Qing. He is an out-and-out powerful person in Daxi's dynasty. Although he looks harmless, he is actually famous for being ruthless. He has maimed countless people, and he is a disaster to Daxi's capital.
In today's situation, it is obvious that he has fallen in love with Su Qingwan. Beauty is a curse.
But this is his Xiao Liang's fiancée, how can she be bullied?
But then Xiao Liang thought about how unfathomable Su Qingwan was, and she was just pretending.
What's more, judging from the current situation, with his cultivation at the fourth level of Qi refining, I am afraid that even a hero cannot save Mei.
The most important thing is that Xiao Liang wants to test Su Qingwan's depth. This is an excellent opportunity.
Seeing Su Qingwan actually taking the initiative to hold Xiao Liang's hand, and seeing Xiao Liang's extremely handsome face, Chen Junhao's anger suddenly burned.
Xiao Liang subconsciously broke away from Su Qingwan's hand and took a few steps back.
"Girl, can we have a good meal now?" Chen Junhao had a smile on his face.
Su Qingwan pointed at Xiao Liang and said loudly: "I have a fiancé!"
Xiao Liang hurriedly dodged into the crowd. He didn't want to do anything that would make him angry.
"Young lady, you can't be right about how you look at people!" Chen Junhao's expression suddenly darkened, murderous intent bursting out.
Su Qingwan stamped her foot and looked at the crowd again. Xiao Liang was gone.
This guy actually left her behind and ran away? Su Qingwan clenched her white teeth tightly.
But in Chen Junhao's eyes, this posture was particularly cute and smart, and he liked it indescribably.
"You bastard, let's see if I don't deal with you when I get back!" Su Qingwan was about to leave, but Chen Junhao blocked her way again.
"Don't mess with me, I'm in a bad mood right now!" Su Qingwan warned.
Chen Junhao smiled and said, "Really? I will definitely make you happy!"
"It seems that I can't understand people anymore!" Su Qingwan rolled up her sleeves, and a strong force suddenly roared out. Several people in front of her were instantly knocked out and smashed against the door of the house.
The sound of banging spread, and the guests at Sihai Restaurant were startled and all looked over.
Chen Junhao's expression suddenly changed and he stepped back involuntarily.
Su Qingwan turned around and walked out of the door without even looking at him.
Xiao Liang did not go far, but hid not far away and watched secretly. He knew earlier that Su Qingwan was not an ordinary person, but he did not expect to be so powerful.
Among Chen Junmo's men, one of them had already entered the second realm of Tiangang Realm, and his spiritual power transformed into Gang, but he failed to catch Su Qingwan's casual blow.
"It's true that Su Yuhan has the best spiritual roots, but this Su Qingwan is also unfathomable. The two sisters of the Su family really don't have a fuel-saving lamp. It stands to reason that people like her can choose not to come back."
"It seems that this woman is planning something, Su Ji, Li Hongyan, the next drama in the Su family should be exciting!"
